The research registry records alpha075's status as WORKING_REFERENCE / NOT_A_PROVEN_BEST_GENERAL_ASSISTANT and dp1_step000020 as REJECTED_FOR_PROMOTION / EXPERIMENT_ONLY, with no default model selected and no release status issued.

R1 and DP1 both stopped themselves at predeclared midpoints on the practical-retention screen (upper bounds 35/162 and 37/162 against the fixed alpha075 lower bound 22/81 = 44/162) without promoting a model or changing the recipe after seeing scores.

DP1: mean DPO loss fell from about ln 2 = 0.693147 to 0.215138 on 160 training pairs and to 0.362027 on 29 heldout pairs, with all 189 reference-relative margins positive, while TRAIN-pair generation joint was 3/32, DPO-heldout 2/29 and 10 of 34 previously accepted answers were lost.

DP1's terminal state retained 24/34 joint passes with 9 recorded content losses; the tenth recorded joint failure is a format violation (a banned pronoun) already present in the baseline text for the same item, so a symmetric reading makes it fail-to-fail. Original scores and the one-item sensitivity are kept separate and no stop rule changes.

dose6 drove its own training rows to NLL 0.0267 while its P3 development score fell to 443/512 and practical27 to [25/162..1/6]: the clearest single case that low training loss establishes nothing about task reliability.

The unified Base SFT curve reached MAIN NLL 0.785709 at 1,209 updates while HOLDOUT NLL reached its minimum 1.657365 at step 403 and then rose to 1.725114; the terminal engineering screen was not passed (P3 412 < 485; HOLDOUT 21/92 not strictly above 24/92).

The matched A/B changed only the within-P3 family loss allocation, preserving the MAIN coefficient and total P3 mass. B gained 10 MEMBERSHIP development passes (67 -> 77) with development true positives 29 -> 46 but true negatives 38 -> 31, while MEMBERSHIP TRAIN NLL rose 0.293201 -> 0.298189 and TRAIN two-label argmax fell 20/32 -> 19/32, and practical27 fell from 5/18 to 13/54.

Five-point A/B interpolation grid at lambda_B 0, 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, 1: P3 418, 420, 426, 430, 429 and MEMBERSHIP 67, 69, 75, 76, 77. From A to Q75 the +12 total decomposes as COPY +1, FIELD +3, JSON -1, MEMBERSHIP +9. Neither frozen screen passed at either new point.

Five observed coefficients cannot prove a criterion is unreachable over the whole continuous segment; the supported statement is that none of the five evaluated points meets the envelope or the historical screen.

alpha075's practical bounds [22/81, 23/81] = [44/162, 46/162] overlap arm A's 5/18 = 45/162, so alpha075 is not established to beat A on practical performance; its QA interval [4,7]/41 likewise overlaps each grid score of 6 or 7.

exp(-mean NLL) is a teacher-forced geometric-mean reference-token probability, not accuracy: at unified-1209 MEMBERSHIP it is 0.57824855… while greedy TRAIN is 20/32 = 0.625 and DEV is 70/128 = 0.546875.
Token share, scalar loss share and gradient share are distinct: the P3 target share is 0.10880514… while the P3 cumulative raw NLL share is 0.00748723…, and neither measures gradient contribution.

Teacher-logit distillation is NOT EVIDENCED anywhere in the PetitGPT weight path: no run in the permitted source set computes or stores teacher logits for PetitGPT, and no KD loss term appears in any recorded PetitGPT objective. KD2 is a separate SmolLM2 lab, not a PetitGPT update.
The same P2 checkpoint, prompts and greedy settings produced 30 differing answers out of 96 between torch 2.2.0+cu121 and torch 2.11.0+cu126, with exactly one label moving.

KD1 (chosen-answer CE on the DP0 chosen sides, 20 updates from alpha075) raised chosen-answer likelihood more than DP1's DPO did on both splits (train chosen NLL 1.385687 -> 1.147131 versus 1.224815; heldout 1.403504 -> 1.303023 versus 1.341860), yet failed the historical retention gate with practical27 upper 19/81 < 22/81 and produced 1 natural gain against 2 losses in a single class.

RKD1 (dense response distillation, stopped at update 77 of 154) lowered TRAIN NLL 2.010386 -> 1.838430 and HOLDOUT NLL 1.825066 -> 1.715917 while HOLDOUT96 joint fell 25/96 -> 20/96 with 4 confirmed gains against 9 losses, and P3's unchanged 487/512 total concealed 13 gains and 13 losses.

RKD2 (rank-16 LoRA, alpha 32, 4,331,520 trainable adapter parameters over 150 wrapped Linear modules, one full pass to update 154) lowered TRAIN NLL to 1.736833 and HOLDOUT to 1.684378 and raised P3 to 489/512, while HOLDOUT96 fell to 18/96 and practical27 to 1/6; every original parameter was verified unchanged tensor by tensor.

Ordinary QA and complete natural-task generation remained limited across the evaluated configurations. Individual points with their own source and label version: unified Base SFT terminal 7/41; R1 step 96 6/41 unk=1; selected model 6/41 unk=2 under the clarification version and 4/41 unk=3 under the scorecard row; on the newer natural suite RKD1 step 77 5/64, R1 step 96 4/64 unk=1, selected model 3/64.
